title: Historias Paralelas de UAE: Póster de Cuadrícula de Cómic Anime Estilo GTA V con Estética de Lujo de Dubai
prompt: UAE Side Stories: City Life – Volume 1. Anime-style digital poster, GTA V–style comic grid, modern Middle Eastern luxury energy. Center panel: A relaxed character in traditional Emirati white kandura leaning on a luxury SUV, with Burj Khalifa, Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, and desert dunes layered in the background. Surrounding panels: Arabic coffee ceremony in traditional majlis, luxury cars racing through Sheikh Zayed Road, sunset over Dubai Marina and desert, falcon with trainer in traditional setting, gold souk market atmosphere, night cityscape with illuminated skyscrapers. Palette: desert gold, royal blue, pristine white, soft film grain. Art style: Anime-style digital poster, GTA V comic grid style with luxury Middle Eastern aesthetic, nostalgic warmth mixed with modern metropolitan energy.
